column1: # Every file under tests/ must appear here, classified. tests/test-inventory-smoke.sh
# enforces it: a new test file without a row fails the suite, and so does a row
# whose file is gone. This exists because eleven test files sat under tests/ for
# months without being listed in tools/scripts/test-all.sh — six of them red — and
# nothing reported it. A test nobody runs is not a gate.
# active  runs in tools/scripts/test-all.sh; must be listed there
# broken  fails today; must NOT be listed until fixed, and needs a reason
# manual  needs a human, a device, or credentials; never in the suite
# obsolete  kept only until deletion is agreed; needs a reason
# A reason on a broken row is a hypothesis, not a diagnosis. Four of the first
# five written here were checked against a real run and two were wrong. Run the
# test and read its output before acting on what this file says about it.
# Do not assert ROADMAP.md text. Three of those five broke on it: the roadmap was
# rewritten from '| Done | ... |' tables to prose, which is what a roadmap is for.
# A roadmap row claims something shipped; assert the thing that shipped instead —
# runtime code, the command registry, a contract doc such as
# docs/RUNTIME_AUTHORITY.md, the release gate, or behavior via
